description: This file is a helper class for managing and filtering Loan-based Chain of Business (COB) operations within the Fineract project. It handles API path matching, loan ID extraction, lock status checking, and command execution for inline COB processing related to loans.

classes.name: LoanCOBFilterHelper
classes.description: A Spring component that provides methods for filtering and handling loan-related API requests, including loan ID extraction, lock status checking, and inline COB execution. It handles both batch and individual API requests, supporting scenarios involving GLOIM accounts and reschedules.

methods.name: getLoanId
methods.description: Extracts the loan ID from the request URL, accounting for external IDs and reschedule requests.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Checks if the request URL indicates an external ID lookup.

methods.name: isRescheduleLoans
methods.description: Determines if the URL pertains to rescheduling loans.

methods.name: isOnApiList
methods.description: Checks whether the request matches the API patterns handled by this helper.

methods.name: calculateRelevantLoanIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of relevant loan IDs from either batch or individual API requests.

methods.name: executeInlineCob
methods.description: Triggers execution of inline COB processing for specified loan IDs.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the object mapper configuration after dependency injection.
